amanda_sales: Heads-up: ZenCloud POC kicks off Wed. They require SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (delta), and role mapping. Can we confirm a 2-week POC scope?
ben_ae: Short: SAML SSO + SCIM 2.0 delta supported. Role mapping via SCIM groups or SAML group claim. Manual CSV import also possible for initial sync.
amanda_sales: Domain proofing question: TXT vs CNAME? Also they asked about customer-managed keys for Private eval.
raj_engineering: Hosted accepts TXT or CNAME; CNAME preferred for easier renewals. Private supports customer KMS/HSM (we need ARN and key policy during onboarding).
liz_seclead: Security Q: signed assertions, encrypted assertions, supported algos? We support signed assertions (RSA-SHA256). Encrypted assertions are NOT enabled on Hosted today (can do on Private after a short setup).
amanda_sales: ZenCloud insists on encrypted assertions by default. Will that block Hosted POC?
ben_ae: Yes, encrypted assertions are a blocker for Hosted. Options: 1) Private eval 2) short dedicated test instance with encryption enabled (adds ~2-3 business days to provision).
raj_engineering: SCIM details: endpoints follow SCIM 2.0. Default flows: /Users and /Groups, delta sync. Example group create: ```curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/scim/v2/Groups" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"displayName":"eng-team","members":[{"value":"u-123"}]}'```
ben_ae: RBAC mapping choices: (a) SCIM group -> Redwood role mapping (recommended), (b) SAML groups claim -> mapping table, (c) manual CSV for one-time onboarding. Note: group name normalization may be needed.
amanda_sales: Pricing ask: they want Dedicated vs Hosted cost comparison and whether SCIM calls count as usage.
ben_ae: Dedicated = reserved monthly commit (we size by qps/concurrency). SCIM/provisioning calls are billed under management API (not per-token generation); small fixed tier + overage. I'll run numbers.
liz_seclead: Add Security Q&A snippet: supported signing algos, TLS ciphers, audit log retention (90 days default), SOC2 link, pen-test coordination contact.
amanda_sales: Can Ops set session affinity for long-lived chat sessions? That affects GPU selection, right?
raj_engineering: For sticky sessions we recommend Dedicated with reserved GPUs; affects latency guarantees and SLA.
amanda_sales: Please make a one-page checklist I can send IdOps by EOD Friday: required SAML metadata fields & DNS steps.
ben_ae: Will draft one-pager and include price ballpark.
liz_seclead: I'll produce the security answers doc + callouts on encrypted assertions and hosted limitations.
opsbot: note: no deploys touching auth flows in last 24h.
amanda_sales: Thanks all — I'll confirm whether encrypted assertions are a hard requirement and loop back. :thumbsup:
